0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The distraught damsel has found herself dispossessed of a treasured keepsake.

24.original: Search for the polished horn necklace near the Northern Staging Point.

25.original: Deliver the polished horn necklace to the distraught damsel in the Crystarium.

48.original: Oh, stranger, please, you must help me!

49.original: I fled here from Holminster Switch, but I lost my necklace along the way. I noticed it was missing as I passed the Church of the First Light, but I couldn't go back...and now the guard tells me that Lakeland is too dangerous for me to go and search for it.

50.original: I know I should be glad that I escaped with my life─and I <hex:021A020203>am<hex:021A020103>, but that necklace was a gift from my father, and it's all that I have to remember him by. If you can travel freely, then please─bring it back to me.

51.original: It must have been somewhere between Holminster Switch and the Church of the First Light that I dropped it. I know I was wearing it when I began to run...

53.original: You did find it! Oh, thank you!

54.original: I've worn this since I was a child─ever since my father first made it for me. The horn he carved for it was magic, he said, and would protect me when I roamed the hills.

55.original: I had thought myself much too old to believe in such things, but nevertheless─when the eaters came for me, I begged it to keep me safe one last time.

56.original: Just then, a young elven woman appeared, brandishing a glowing blade. She cut quite the dashing figure as she fought to protect me─like a prince from a faerie tale. And when she stood over the vanquished eaters, she smiled at me, and said, “You're safe.”

57.original: I knew then that the necklace had answered my prayers, for that could not have been anything but magic.

58.original: As long as I have it, I know that I will be all right.
